about: The owner's decision for each snapshot schema, one entry per schema, read by scripts/audit-backup-schemas.mjs. A dated snapshot TABLE in public or au is decided the same way under <schema>.<table>. A schema or table past 90 days with no entry here is never offered for dropping. decision: drop | export-then-drop | keep (keep takes an optional until date). Rule: docs/security/backup-schema-retention.md, 'The owner decides each one'.
